mechanism: Tobramycin (aminoglycoside) causes nephrotoxicity and can impair renal clearance of bictegravir, potentially increasing bictegravir exposure; bictegravir may also increase tobramycin levels through unknown mechanisms.
action: Monitor renal function closely (serum creatinine, eGFR) and tobramycin/bictegravir levels if used concurrently; consider alternative antibiotics if possible, particularly in patients with baseline renal impairment.
